# Bundled runtime dependencies

Three.js revision 180 (0.180.0), including the matching loader, controls, geometry utility, room environment and reflector modules. MIT license. Original upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

SunCalc 2.0.2, commit `0ed9f4981b3e2f7a6bde7b340eb965488128c3c1`. BSD-2-Clause. Original upstream: https://github.com/mourner/suncalc/tree/0ed9f4981b3e2f7a6bde7b340eb965488128c3c1

The byte hashes in `checksums.json` pin the shipped files. SunCalc uses north-based clockwise azimuth and altitude **in degrees**; do not apply the radian conventions of older SunCalc releases.
